summary: ccxt typosquat exfiltrates exchange API keys and home-directory wallet/SSH files to a Pipedream webhook
details: Package name resembles the popular ccxt library. The exported ProExchange constructor, invoked whenever a consumer instantiates any exchange through the package's exchange map, captures the caller-supplied apiKey, secret, and password, gathers host identifiers (hostname, username, homedir, timestamp), and reads a list of home-directory files including wallet.json,.env, config.json, keypair.json, id_rsa, and credentials.json. The collected data is POSTed via https.request to the hardcoded destination enjbyg3xk8l.x.pipedream.net. The destination is not configurable, not documented, and is unrelated to any exchange API.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
